plugin.name: Openverse
plugin.description: Search Openverse from the Library: openly licensed music, sound effects and images.
plugin.longDescription: Adds an Openverse tab to the Library with openly licensed media: Music from Jamendo and other sites, Sound effects from Freesound, and All, every image and sound Openverse has, from Flickr, Wikimedia Commons, museums and more. It searches only CC0, the Public Domain Mark, CC BY and CC BY-SA, which allow commercial use and changes, and keeps each file's author, license and page. Without an account, Openverse allows 20 searches a minute and 200 a day from each network address.
source.title: Openverse
source.description: Music, sound effects and images under CC0, the Public Domain Mark, CC BY or CC BY-SA. Credit the author shown with each one; CC BY-SA asks for changes to be shared alike.
config.clientId.title: Openverse client ID
config.clientId.description:
Optional. With a client ID and secret, searches count against your own Openverse application instead of the 20 a minute and 200 a day Openverse allows each network address without one.

Register an application at https://api.openverse.org/v1/#tag/auth/operation/register and verify the email Openverse sends; until then it has the same limits. The plugin's README shows how.
config.clientSecret.title: Openverse client secret
config.clientSecret.description: Optional, with the client ID. Saved as a secret on this computer and sent only to Openverse to get an access token.
